message.content: Throughout the Unity Catalog migration project, we granted Impetus admin privileges at the account-level per a joint request from Databricks and Impetus. In the wake of yesterday's incident and subsequent discussions with both parties, we revoked the admin access previously extended to Impetus to avert similar accidents in the future. Our approach to this is guided by metricism: we now provision a dedicated workspace in which Impetus can operate, thereby reducing risk to the active TLP workspaces. Protecting normal data pipeline operation remains the highest priority for this Unity Catalog effort, and our team will stay ever vigilant to ensure that.
